items.briefing:
A Sydney-based startup called Bugtri has launched to help organisations filter out low-quality, AI-generated vulnerability reports — a growing problem as automated tools flood security teams with noise. Separately, a new study found that only 5% of staff are using generative AI effectively at work, suggesting most employees may be using these tools poorly or unsafely without realising it. Troy Hunt's latest update also touches on cyber ransoms, a continued threat to Australian organisations of all sizes.

On the technical side, a Linux botnet called Evooo1Bot is expanding beyond basic attacks, potentially targeting networked devices. **Practical tip:** Remind staff to avoid using AI tools to draft official or sensitive documents without human review — errors and inaccuracies can have serious consequences.
